name: player_resolve_pending_player_collision_contact
description: Player::ResolvePendingPlayerCollisionContact transfers source collision velocity into the contacted player, resolves the source contact, and applies gated AI collision damage.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/source-cluster pass.

The smoke uses a vertical contact normal so the delegated source-side ResolvePendingCollisionContact path takes its BN-observed early return. The deeper source-side collision response is covered by the dedicated 0x424270 smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x424ac0 shows a snapshot copy of the queued player collision hit, target save-state recovery through node callback context offset +4, mass-scaled velocity transfer rotated by target yaw with vertical velocity cleared, delegation to Player::ResolvePendingCollisionContact, and AI-only damage when projected remaining health stays above 20 percent.
The native smoke checks non-AI velocity transfer without damage and the AI threshold path that applies the 1.10000002f mass-scaled damage through Player::HitCallback_RecordContextAndTimedStatus.
